answers.core: While a custom shader could do, it's more convenient to reuse the existing Light2D node and since Blending Mode is an enum, internal code is the best place to add a new value.
answers.workaround: No, I can write my own shader to grab to the max value of some combination of values but that won't be simple. I used stencil once to make custom masks but I'm not sure you can use multiple values of them.
